description: A sweep's maturation decides each candle once (audit M3, s5-v15): on a candle an earlier pass decided, a displacement exists only where the sweep's stop hunt was published. Found live 2026-09-15: a LINKUSDT M5 LIQUIDITY_SWEEP_DISPLACED written 456 periods after its candle. Deterministic tests, so one battery run is a verdict. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/maturation_decided_once.json

mutations.name: a decided candle's displacement is judged again
a published stop hunt is not replayed on its decided candle
the pass does not hand its decided candle to the maturation walk
